title: Основы туристско-краеведческой работы
description: *Fundamentals of tourist and local history work* — in practice a course on **heritage tourism**: resources, interpretation, marketing, law, economics and visitor experience. Content in English. Notes for weeks 6, 7, 9–13 are based on the lecture slides; weeks 1–5, 8, 14, 15 — on the syllabus annotation and open sources (marked). The exam schedule says written, the syllabus says oral — check with the teacher.
